name: Slice Filling (Simple)
definition: Fills a 2D slice of the voxel grid along one axis by scanning from both ends towards the center. It sets bits in a buffer for empty space until it hits an existing solid voxel, then stops that direction.
summary: Slice Filling (Simple) is a voxelization method that fills mesh interiors by scanning 2D slices from both ends toward the center, differing from global connectivity approaches.
